mentions.name: DB Pro
mentions.description: DB Pro is a modern desktop data workbench for developers and data engineers that goes beyond a query editor, combining visual data exploration, inline editing, dashboards, and Jupyter notebook-style workbooks for queries, notes, and experiments in one place. Version 1 launched recently and the journey is being documented in a public devlog series.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We are working on DB Pro, a modern desktop data workbench for developers and data engineers.

The focus is on going beyond a query editor and building a complete environment for working with data. Visual exploration, inline editing, dashboards, and Jupyter notebook style workbooks for queries, notes, and experiments all in one place.
